# copick export ctf

<span class="source-badge source-badge--core" title="Part of copick core">core</span>

*Export the CTF fits of tilt series.*

## Usage

```bash
copick export ctf [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
|--------|------|---------|-------------|
| `-c, --config` | path | — | Path to the configuration file. |
| `--run-names, -r` | text · multiple | — | Specific run names to process (default: all runs). Repeatable; pass -r once per run. |
| `--tiltseries-uri` | text | **required** | Tilt series whose CTF fits to export (e.g. 'raw'). |
| `--output-dir` | directory | **required** | Output directory for exported files. |
| `--output-format` | choice (aretomo3 \| ctffind4) | `aretomo3` | 'aretomo3': '<run>_CTF.txt' in ascending tilt angle; 'ctffind4': '<run>_ctffind4.txt' in stack order. |
| `--debug / --no-debug` | boolean flag | `False` | Enable debug logging. |

## Examples

```bash
copick export ctf -c config.json --tiltseries-uri raw --output-dir out
```
